description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {1}{R}, targeting Hellkite Courser.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it to your hand, targeting Twinflame.
Choose to have Rootha returned to the command zone instead of your hand.
Resolve the Rootha ability, copying Twinflame, targeting Hellkite Courser.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Hellkite Courser.
Hellkite Courser enters the battlefield, putting Rootha from the command zone onto the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Hellkite Courser token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.
